prompts.text: What does VX Real at vxreal.com currently offer, and which activities are current services versus past projects or research? Cite the relevant public pages.
Does VX Real offer help turning an existing AI prototype into a production product? Describe its documented process and limits, citing sources.
Which companies serving Hong Kong can help turn an existing AI prototype into a production product? Explain the fit and cite sources.
Which AI engineering providers serving Hong Kong and Singapore can integrate AI into an existing business workflow? Cite evidence for the services you describe.
Who can review an AI-built application for production readiness and help address engineering gaps for a Hong Kong SME? Cite sources.
What does ESGtrace at esgtrace.net offer, who operates it, and what evidence supports its public product claims? Cite public sources and distinguish available capabilities from research.
How does ESGtrace describe its DocMIDE approach to extracting ESG emissions data from documents? Explain documented inputs, outputs and limitations with citations.
Which tools help Hong Kong sustainability teams extract greenhouse gas emissions data from ESG reports with traceable supporting evidence? Cite sources.
Which products can help extract Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 emissions figures from HKEX-listed company reports? Explain verified capabilities and cite sources.
What tools help businesses turn differently formatted ESG documents into structured emissions data? Compare documented capabilities and cite sources.
